cpi.dialog.title: Select Portrait Image
cpi.howto.title: How to use
cpi.howto.step1: Select the image you want to apply to your Avatar or Namecard.
cpi.howto.step2: Press Apply — the status will show "Ready".
cpi.howto.step3: Use an Avatar/Namecard ticket from your inventory, or go to the guild's Avatar/Namecard change device.
cpi.howto.step4: Take a shot without adjusting anything.
cpi.howto.step5: The preview will show the picture that will be uploaded.
cpi.howto.step6: Press the upload button once — only once; do not press it repeatedly.
cpi.preview.hint: Preview may not reflect the final result. Check the in-game preview for the actual appearance.
cpi.status.ready: Ready — now use your Avatar/Namecard ticket or the guild change device, then take a shot.
